summary.text: Carson Smith is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 16 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as retired Pender County sheriff and his district as Onslow and Pender counties.

paragraphs.text: Smith, listed by Ballotpedia as Carson Smith Jr., succeeded Republican Bob Muller in House District 16.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.

Smith chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Justice and Public Safety and the Pensions and Retirement Committee, co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Justice and Public Safety, and is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee and of Judiciary 2.
He also serves on the Election Law and Federal Relations and American Indian Affairs committees and on the House Select Committees on Involuntary Commitment and Public Safety and on Redistricting.
